Hi Samira / Tom — Wed 2025-08-27 14:00–14:45 PST is confirmed (calendar invite sent: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=veridian-demo-20250827-14-00).

Pre-reads attached and agenda below:
- Pre-reads: capacity-checklist.pdf, short snapshot you attached.
- Agenda (30–45m):
  1) Quick intro + high-level architecture (5m)
  2) Traffic pattern review & sizing (10m)
  3) Latency SLOs, caching & batching behavior (10m)
  4) Quantization tradeoffs + recommended model variants (10m)
  5) Next steps / mutual action plan (5m)

On quantization: at a high level — aggressive 4-bit quantization reduces GPU memory and can enable higher concurrency within the same Dedicated pool, but it can introduce increased token-level compute which sometimes raises tail latency depending on kernel choices and model. For a strict p95 <=100ms goal at ~1,100 qps bursts, we typically recommend a two-pronged approach: (a) reserve headroom in Dedicated pool sizing (target ~1.3–1.5x expected peak), and (b) use mixed precision / 8-bit + targeted 4-bit for non-critical models where quality regression is acceptable. We’ll have our Solutions Engineer (Priyom) show latency profiles versus quantization during the call.

Next steps: I’ve looped Neha (CS handoff) and Priyom (solutions). If anything changes on timing, say so and we’ll adjust.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
